chapter: Early music and the Jack Carey band
title: Moving to New Orleans in 1919 and joining Jack Carey
summary: After demobilization he settled in New Orleans in 1919, bought an instrument from C.G. Conn in 1920 and first played with Jack Carey, then Chris Kelly.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well, after I put the violin down, I came right after the war. I was here in 1919. I've been here ever since. You moved here right after the war. Right after the war. When I got demobilized out of the army, I came here and lived here. I've been here ever since. All right. I bought a band jewel in 1920 from Grunewald Music Store. Yeah. Not Grunewald. Where are lines? C.G. Conn.
Oh, Conn. Yeah. They had a story.
I bought a tenor van jewel. It cost $150 there. And learned that the first band that I started playing with when I bought the van jewel, it was Jack Carrey's band.
Oh, yeah. I knew his brother Mutt, but I never knew Jack Carrey.
Well, Mutt, I know Mutt, too. Well, I started playing with Jack. I played with Jack a very long time. Then, jumps around and played with Chris Kelly.
